steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each file is placed by its effect on install, offline use and locale handling.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Manifest missing the 512 pixel icon
findings.fix: Add the 512 pixel icon with its purpose

findings.title: Cache holds a stale page
findings.fix: Version the cache and remove the old entry

findings.title: Date shown in the server time zone
findings.fix: Format the date in the user's time zone

outcome.notChecked: Behaviour on each platform's install flow unless tested, server-side date handling outside the scope, and time zone database updates on the server.
